speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To help me understand what is happening inside you, can you tell me if your abdomen looks like a tight drum or feels very firm when I touch it?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing that tenderness; it suggests significant abdominal pain. Have you noticed any vomiting, and if so, is it forcefully projected as green or yellow bile? Also, has your baby passed any stool or gas since the symptoms began?

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Small Bowel Obstruction (likely due to Intussusception or Malrotation with Volvulus)
